## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Debug build succeeds
- [ ] Release build succeeds
- [ ] Automated tests pass
- [ ] Vulkan path checked, or not applicable
- [ ] OptiX path checked, or not applicable
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices updated where needed

## Rendering evidence

For visual changes, include the GPU/driver, backend, settings, and before/after captures. Only attach assets that may be redistributed.
